data.title: Fake CAPTCHA Campaign Redirect Chain Detection
data.description: Detect web access patterns consistent with fake CAPTCHA campaigns: user visits a page with CAPTCHA verification UI, is instructed to copy/execute clipboard content (PowerShell, cmd, mshta), which triggers malware or stealer download. CrowdStrike documented a +563% increase in fake CAPTCHA campaigns in 2025. Used by BRASH SPIDER (Doshell Stealer) and COOKIE SPIDER (SHAMOS).
falsepositives: Legitimate CAPTCHA services followed by coincidental command execution
Developer workflows involving browser-based tools and terminal commands
